solvable.name: curl
solvable.summary: A Tool for Transferring Data from URLs
solvable.description: Curl is a client to get documents and files from or send documents to a server using any of the supported protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, TFTP, DICT, TELNET, LDAP, or FILE). The command is designed to work without user interaction or any kind of interactivity.
